title: SonicWall SonicOS: CISA added CVE-2026-19868 to KEV, a SAML authentication bypass (including MFA) on the SSL VPN, exposed only if SAML-based login is enabled.
content_md:
SonicWall SonicOS: CISA added CVE-2026-19868 to the KEV catalog, a SAML authentication bypass (including MFA) on the SSL VPN, exposed only if SAML-based login is enabled.

via Mastodon https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-flags-sonicwall-sonicos-mfa-bypass.html

CVE-2026-19868.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-19868 to the KEV catalogue for SonicWall SonicOS SAML MFA bypass on SSL VPN.
